answer_1.quote: we propose a co-generation model to generate act and response sequences jointly
answer_1.outputs: Natural language responses and dialogue act sequences

answer_2.quote: We use the Inform Rate and Request Success metrics to evaluate dialog completion, with one measuring whether a system has provided an appropriate entity and the other assessing if it has answered all requested attributes. Besides, we use BLEU to measure the fluency of generated responses.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human study to evaluate our model by crowd-sourcing.
answer_4.guideline: Completion measures if the response correctly answers a user query, including relevance and informativeness. Readability reflects how fluent, natural and consistent the response is.
